subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Should OpenClaw expose supportedReasoningEfforts, reasoningEffortMap, and the Responses supportsReasoningEffort switch as durable per-model compatibility configuration for custom OpenAI-compatible providers?
rationale: These fields extend the user-configurable model contract across registry validation, shared LLM types, capability presentation, and two provider transports; choosing their long-term shape is product and compatibility policy rather than a narrow mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve the explicit compat contract
options.body: Keep the three narrowly scoped metadata controls, require documented conservative semantics, and land after current-head transport proof.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Retain only the minimum existing-compatible metadata needed for xhigh and defer any broader mapping or Responses switch until an owner-defined API proposal exists.

recommendation.title: Approve the explicit compat contract
recommendation.body: Keep the three narrowly scoped metadata controls, require documented conservative semantics, and land after current-head transport proof.
